idea.title: Faceless AI history YouTube channel (AdSense)

source.text: A faceless YouTube channel that posts AI-generated history videos and earns from AdSense. Launch country US, budget $500, 10 hours a week, goal side income, no special edge. Just go: do not ask questions. Use the slug faceless-youtube.

idea.customer: US viewers of long-form YouTube history videos; advertisers pay through AdSense (implied by the input)
idea.solution: AI-generated history videos (AI script help, AI voice, AI visuals) posted on a faceless YouTube channel
assumptions: Long-form videos: history Shorts pay about $0.04-0.10 per 1,000 views, so Shorts are not a revenue path
RPM of $6 per 1,000 US views, the midpoint of a $4-9 tertiary range for history
The channel applies to YPP after 2027-02-01, under the 8,000-watch-hour rule
Tool stack: ElevenLabs Creator + Google AI Pro + CapCut Pro, about $62/month
About 5 hours per video, so about 8 videos a month at 10 h/week; founder time valued at $15/h
Headless run: no history audience, list or channel today (the input says no special edge)

confidence.note: RPM and subscriber data are vendor/tertiary; a history-specific RPM dataset and Google Trends data would raise it

gross_margin.note: YouTube keeps 45% of long-form ad revenue, so the creator margin is 55% before tool costs.

ltv_cac.note: About $6 earned per 1,000 views vs about $166 of time and tools to get them in year 1: LTV:CAC 0.04 (estimate).

pricing_power.note: Price taker: viewers pay $0 and the ad auction sets RPM at about $4-9 per 1,000 views (tertiary).

build_effort.note: A first AI-narrated video takes days with off-the-shelf tools; guides push it as a beginner format.

skills_match.note: Scripting, research and editing are learnable; the user states no prior video skills.

capital_needed.note: About $62/month of tools fits the $500 budget for about 8 months.

time_to_mvp.note: First upload within 1-2 weeks at 10 h/week.

sales_cycle.note: No ad money until 1,000 subscribers and 8,000 watch hours (from 2027-02-01): 12+ months.

channel_readiness.note: YouTube recommendations exist, but only 30.77% of channels with 52+ uploads reach 1,000 subs in a year.

search_demand.note: Mass audience: OverSimplified alone has 9.65M subscribers (2026-10).

trend.note: No 5-year trend checked; AI sleep-history videos still reach 2.3M views (2025-09).

willingness_to_pay.note: Viewers expect it free; advertisers pay a modest RPM (Education median $10.22, tertiary).

free_alternatives.note: R1: the same videos are free from human and AI channels, and Veo makes free AI clips in Shorts.

competitor_density.note: R3: 278 AI-only channels in the top 15,000 and 6 named AI history channels (2025).

differentiation.note: R3: no edge; Sleepless Historian already posts AI history about 4 times a week.

legal_regulatory.note: No licence needed, but raw AI output is not copyrightable and realistic AI scenes need a label.

platform_dependency.note: One platform: templated AI content is not monetizable and demonetization hits the whole channel.

market_risk.note: Crackdowns and viewer backlash against AI slop are growing; even human faceless channels got hit.

skills.note: No stated video, scripting or history skills.

assets.note: No audience, data or network in the niche.

interest.note: Goal stated as side income, not a passion for history.

som.reasoning: Optimistic: reach YPP late in year 1, then 30,000 monetized views x $6 RPM / 1,000 = $180; base case $0

competitors_found.reasoning: 4 human channels (OverSimplified, Kings and Generals, Historia Civilis, History Time) + 6 AI history channels named by 404 Media

competitor_price_range.reasoning: Every competing history channel is free to watch; revenue comes from ads

price.unit: USD gross ad revenue per 1,000 views
price.reasoning: Creator RPM $6 (midpoint of $4-9) / 0.55 creator share = $10.91 gross

cac.reasoning: Cost per video ($62 tools / 8 videos + 5 h x $15) = $83; ~500 views per video in year 1 (assumed) -> $83 / 0.5 = $166 per 1,000 views

ltv.reasoning: Creator RPM $6 per 1,000 long-form US views (tertiary $4-9 range), and only after YPP

ltv_cac.reasoning: LTV $6 / CAC $166 = 0.04; even with founder time at $0, $6 / $15.5 tool cost = 0.39

payback_months.reasoning: No revenue before 1,000 subs + 8,000 watch hours; LTV:CAC below 1 after that

fixed_costs_month.reasoning: ElevenLabs Creator $22 + Google AI Pro $19.99 + CapCut Pro $19.99 = $61.98

break_even_customers_per_month.reasoning: $62 fixed costs / $6 per 1,000 views x 1,000 = 10,333 views a month, once in YPP

time_to_first_revenue_weeks.reasoning: vidIQ: 30.77% of channels with 52+ uploads reach 1,000 subs in 360 days; 8,000 watch hours on top -> 52+ weeks for the lucky third

verdict.launch_reason: The user's country, and US views carry the highest RPM.

type_checks.note: History RPM is about $4-9 per 1,000 US views (tertiary), decent; but $500/month needs about 83,000 monetized views a month.
YouTube does not monetize AI content made with generic templates, and removes monetization from the entire channel.

verdict.cheapest_test: Pitch 50 small history channels (10K-200K subs) a $150 AI-visuals pilot within 7 days; 1+ paid pilot or archive it.
kill_criteria: Fewer than 3 positive replies to 50 pitches by day 7 -> stop the service test
0 paid pilots ($150 or more) by day 14 -> archive the idea

rescue.change: Sell AI-visual production to existing history channels (service) instead of running your own channel
rescue.why: Fixes ltv_cac, sales_cycle and platform_dependency: clients pay per video within weeks, no YPP gate
rescue.effort: 2-4 weeks to a portfolio and 50 pitches
rescue.requires: A 3-video sample reel and cold outreach to 50+ creators

rescue.change: Run a human-scripted, own-voice niche history channel (e.g. one US region) and treat year 1 as audience building
rescue.why: Eases platform_dependency and differentiation, but ad money stays below cost in year 1, so R7 still applies
rescue.requires: Real research and voice work; a reason to love the topic

narrative.answer: **NO-GO**. With no edge, an AI history channel earns **nothing for 12+ months**: YouTube doubles the bar to 8,000 watch hours in February 2027, demonetizes templated AI content channel-wide, and AI sleep-history channels already flood the niche.
tldr: Revenue is gated: 1,000 subscribers plus **8,000 watch hours** before the first cent, from 2027-02-01.
YouTube's policy names **templated AI content** as not monetizable, and enforces it on the whole channel.
At about $6 per 1,000 views, year-1 LTV:CAC is **0.04**: the $500 runs out long before the ads pay.

key_findings.title: The bar to earn doubles in February 2027
key_findings.detail: New YPP applicants need 1,000 subscribers and **8,000 watch hours** in 365 days from 2027-02-01, double today's 4,000 (Google, 2026).

key_findings.title: YouTube demonetizes this exact format
key_findings.detail: Its policy bars "AI-generated content made with generic or unoriginal templates" and removes monetization from the **entire channel** (YouTube Help, 2025).

key_findings.title: The niche is already flooded
key_findings.detail: 404 Media named **6 AI sleep-history channels** in 2025; Sleepless Historian alone has 702K subscribers and posts about 4 videos a week.

narrative.recommendation: Don't launch the AdSense channel. If you want to use AI video skills for side income, test selling **AI visuals to existing history channels** for 7 days instead.
narrative.steelman: AI cuts a history video to a few hours and about $62/month of tools, the audience is huge (OverSimplified has 9.65M subscribers), and AI channels like Sleepless Historian reached 702K subscribers. The evidence: those channels grew before the 2026 crackdown and the doubled bar, and earn about $1-3K/month at 702K subs.

premortem.cause: The channel stalls far below 1,000 subscribers and 8,000 watch hours, so it never earns.
premortem.early_signal: Under 200 views per video on average after the first 8 uploads

premortem.cause: YPP rejects or later demonetizes the channel as inauthentic, templated AI content.
premortem.early_signal: Thumbnails and scripts look interchangeable with 3+ existing AI history channels; 0 comments on 8 videos

premortem.cause: Tool costs and 10 h/week burn the $500 before any revenue arrives.
premortem.early_signal: Over $120 spent in month 1 with under 1,000 total views

changes.what: YouTube renamed repetitious content to inauthentic content, aimed at mass-produced videos
Veo 3 Fast made free AI video clips inside YouTube Shorts, flooding supply
YouTube removed 16-18 large AI slop channels (about 35M subscribers)
YouTube reworked its inauthentic content guidance into 3 categories
YPP entry bar for new channels doubles to 8,000 watch hours from 2027-02-01

why_now.note: The cheap-AI window opened in 2025 and is closing: supply exploded, then YouTube raised the bar and started removing templated channels.

icp.who: US adults (skewing male, 25-34) who watch long-form YouTube history to learn or to fall asleep
icp.pays_for_today: $0: free channels such as OverSimplified (9.65M subs) and Kings and Generals (about 4.2M)
icp.budget: $0 for viewers; advertisers pay a creator RPM of about $4-9 per 1,000 US views (tertiary, 2026)
icp.trigger: Bedtime, a commute, or a topic in the news or a new film

customer.segment: US viewers of long-form history videos; advertisers buy their attention
customer.pain: Want engaging history to learn from or to sleep to
customer.today: Watch free human-made channels and a growing number of AI sleep-history channels

use_cases.name: AdSense AI history channel (the idea)
use_cases.effort: 10 h/week for 12+ months before any revenue

use_cases.name: AI-visual production for existing history channels

free_alternative.evidence: Viewers already get the same history free from human channels (OverSimplified 9.65M subs) and AI ones; Veo 3 makes free AI clips inside Shorts since 2025-09.

strong_competitor.evidence: OverSimplified has 9.65M subscribers (2026-10), Kings and Generals about 4.2M, Historia Civilis 1.09M; AI rival Sleepless Historian 702K.

graveyard.evidence: YouTube removed 16-18 AI slop channels in January 2026; a solo AI faceless channel post-mortem: 6 months, 640 subscribers, failed.

no_distribution.evidence: Searched channel-growth data: YouTube recommendations are a real channel; 30.77% of small channels posting 52+ videos reached 1,000 subs within 360 days (vidIQ, 2026).

costs_eat_margin.evidence: Checked tool prices: about $62/month fixed (ElevenLabs $22, Google AI Pro $19.99, CapCut Pro $19.99); creator keeps 55% of ad revenue, so the margin is not the problem.

weak_demand.evidence: Searched for demand signals: history draws mass audiences (OverSimplified 9.65M subs; an AI sleep-history video at 2.3M views). No 5-year Google Trends check was run.

legal_platform_risk.evidence: YouTube bars "AI-generated content made with generic or unoriginal templates" from monetization, channel-wide; the YPP bar doubles to 8,000 hours on 2027-02-01.

saturated_wave.evidence: Kapwing counted 278 AI-only channels among the top 15,000 (2025-10); 404 Media named 6 AI history ones: Sleepless Historian, Boring History Bites, History Before Sleep, The Snoozetorian, Historian Sleepy, Dreamoria.

competitors.gap: Already owns the AI sleep-history format

scenarios.name: Pessimistic
scenarios.note: Month 12: about 3,000 views a month, far from YPP; $0 revenue, $500 gone by month 8

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.note: Month 12: growing but still under 1,000 subs / 8,000 h; $0 revenue

scenarios.name: Optimistic
scenarios.note: Monetized by month 12: 50,000 views x $6 RPM = $300/month (estimate)

risks.risk: YPP rejection or channel-wide demonetization as inauthentic content
risks.mitigation: Human-written scripts, own voice, original analysis
52+ uploads a year; niche topics with low competition

risks.risk: Copycats re-upload AI visuals and narration; raw AI output is not copyrightable
Viewer and press backlash against inaccurate AI history
risks.mitigation: Cite sources on screen; fact-check every script

risks.risk: Realistic AI scenes need a synthetic-content label

test_plan.step: List 50 history channels with 10K-200K subscribers that post at least monthly
Make a 60-second AI-visual sample for a real script from 3 of those channels
test_plan.verify: 3 samples done in 6 hours or less

test_plan.step: Send 50 pitches offering a $150 one-video pilot

test_plan.verify: 3+ positive replies and 1+ paid pilot, or stop

rescue.change: Sell AI-visual production to existing history channels (service) instead of running your own channel
rescue.why: Fixes ltv_cac, sales_cycle and platform_dependency: clients pay per video within weeks, no YPP gate
rescue.effort: 2-4 weeks to a portfolio and 50 pitches
rescue.requires: A 3-video sample reel and cold outreach to 50+ creators

rescue.change: Run a human-scripted, own-voice niche history channel (e.g. one US region) and treat year 1 as audience building
rescue.why: Eases platform_dependency and differentiation, but ad money stays below cost in year 1, so R7 still applies
rescue.requires: Real research and voice work; a reason to love the topic

narrative.lesson: Ad-funded channels pay after the audience, not before: without an edge, the gate is the business.
